documents.title: Prototype Cup 2025 Technical Regulations
pages: TR-4.2 Minimum race mass is 1040 kg including the driver.
TR-7.1 The control tyre is RV-S1 and no substitute compound is permitted.

documents.title: Prototype Cup 2026 Technical Regulations
pages: TR-4.2 Minimum race mass is 1065 kg including the driver.
TR-7.1 The control tyre is RV-S2. One wet-weather substitute is permitted.

documents.title: RVX-9 Service Manual
pages: Brake bleed sequence: right rear, left rear, right front, left front.
Use DOT 4 racing fluid. Do not mix silicone-based fluid.
Torque table: caliper bridge bolt 42 N m; bleed screw 11 N m.
Safety: support the vehicle on four rated stands before working below it.
The diagnostic connector is X17 beneath the left instrument panel.
